question: The espionage screen country_espionage: its view class, construction, Show, Update; the country list, tabs and sorts; own_country_info; country_info with what it hides at which level of knowledge; the sections; every command it posts; every tooltip.

structs.name: CEspionageView
structs.comment: The intelligence screen: country view index 4 (the fifth view the in-game screen makes; CCountryView view_index 4), main window `country_espionage`, second window `topcolor_espionage`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, section D.
structs.evidence: `push 0x37C; call operator_new` at 0x659C5D immediately before the one call of CEspionageView::CEspionageView (0x659C7A); the constructor writes vftable 0x15CC10C at 0x61EB87 and its last stores are +0x370/+0x374/+0x378 (0x61F000-0x61F00C); RTTI gives CEspionageView the single base CCountryView at offset 0. Wrong if a store past +0x37B turns up in the view's code (0x61C800-0x62EF70).

structs.name: CSpyMissionEntry
structs.comment: One row of spy_missions (the chosen country) or our_spy_missions (the played country): window `spy_mission_entry`, one spy mission of one target. RTTI base CStandardlistboxItem at 0, a second table at +0x1C (0x15CC184). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, D.5.
structs.evidence: `push 0x90; call operator_new` before both constructor calls (0x623A4B, 0x623CF7); vftable 0x15CC14C written by the constructor 0x61E460.

addresses.name: CEspionageView::CEspionageView
addresses.comment: The constructor: CCountryView::CCountryView(this, idler, `country_espionage`, `topcolor_espionage`, view_index 4), vftable 0x15CC10C, fourteen button glues (+0xD8 sort by name .. +0x344 Ministers tab; the handlers are in the struct record), the sort handler +0x1E0 = OnSortByName, the list handler +0x1E4 = ListAll, the direction byte +0x1F0 = 1, the selected tag '---'/0, +0x370 = 0, +0x374 = +0x378 = -1. **The first chosen country is the one the played country feels most threat from**: every country of the database (index 0 up) that owns a province and is not the played one, Diplomacy[c]->threat (+0x5C) compared with `>` against a start of -1000000 - so the first of equals in database order, and at no threat anywhere the first such country. Then BuildWidgets, both windows hidden, country_listbox's slot 14 with 1 and its byte +0x138 cleared. `ret 8`. One caller, 0x659C7A, after `new 0x37C`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, D.1.

addresses.comment: Slot 6, every frame while open (its slot 7). (1) UpdateFactionBoxes, (2) RefreshOwnCountryInfo - both every frame; nothing more without a chosen country (+0x1F8). Where spies differs from +0x374, or MonthRefreshKey() from +0x378: RefreshSpyCount and FillProductionSection - the whole country_info is made again; otherwise only each unit_queue row's slot 8. (6) attempt_coup_button: **enabled (slot 46) where spies > 0, the played country's covert_ops_points about the chosen one (+0xF4) >= COUP_COVERT_OPS_COST, and CanAttemptCoup(chosen, played); otherwise disabled (slot 47) - never hidden.** (7) covert_ops_value = itoa(covert_ops_points / 1000). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, D.1.

addresses.name: CEspionageView::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CEspionageView::BuildTooltip(CEspionageView* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: **Slot 10 of CEspionageView (vftable 0x15CC10C): every tooltip of the intelligence screen, by the element's name.** political_popularity_chart: the slice under the mouse (0xAA3270) - the ideology's slot 14 for the chosen country + ' - §Y' + the slice + '%§W', delayed QUALIFIES_FOR_CABINET with COUNT = chosen cabinet (+0x112C)[ideology]. value_spies_caught: ESP_SPIES_CAUGHT, NUM = played spiescaught (+0x11D4); delayed the contributors to the played country's MODIFIER_COUNTER_ESPIONAGE (55) through CModifier slot 9 at scale 1000. foreign_spy_actions_indicator: DETECTED_SPY_ACTIONS alone. value_our_neutrality: ESP_NEUTRALITY, NUM = FormatFloat(effective_neutrality/1000, 0). value_active_spies (the name answers in both windows): ESP_NUM_SPIES with NUM = played spies in the chosen country (level/1000) and NATION, delayed ESP_NUM_SPIES_DELAYED with PRIO = the presence's priority 0..3. The seven resource boxes, ic_number, diplomacy_number, espionage_number, manpower_number, dissent_number, national_unity_number, leadership_number: ESP_ESTIMATE_RES with NUM = **the text the box already shows** and ITEM = GoodName(GoodIndexByShortName(the name up to its '_')), MODIFIER_IC, DISTRIBUTE_DIPLOMACY, DISTRIBUTE_ESPIONAGE, MANPOWER_IRO, DISSENT_IRO, ESP_NATIONAL_UNITY, PV_LEADERSHIP; delayed ESP_ESTIMATE_RES_DELAY. attempt_coup_button: 0x4F7EE0(chosen, out, &played). Rows of spy_missions / our_spy_missions owning the element (row window slot 22): CSpyMissionEntry_BuildTooltip; of minister_list1 / minister_list2: CForeignMinisterItem_BuildTooltip. Nothing else answers. Body 0x21FCD0..0x2225CF: a `ret 8` at 0x2225CD is followed three bytes later by a fresh `push ebp` at 0x2225D0, so the `ret 4` at 0x22269A belongs to the next function - trap 2. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, D.8.
addresses.revises: Raised from inferred: the signature's types (out is a GuiTooltipText, the second argument the hovered element) and the whole dispatch read on the listing; the old comment's list of keys was right and incomplete.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x61FCD0-0x6225CF read branch by branch: the name tests through 0x40C3C0 at 0x620170 .. 0x622308; the out record initialised at [esp+0xF0] and copied with GuiTooltipText::CopyConstruct at 0x6225A6; text appends to [esp+0xFC]/delayed to [esp+0x118] (three pushes pending); `ret 8` at 0x6225CD, eax = out at 0x6225C0. Wrong if an element name test exists that the dump of 0x61FCD0-0x6225D0 does not show.

addresses.name: CEspionageView::FillEstimates
addresses.comment: **What the screen shows of the chosen country and how much it hides.** A fresh MT19937 on the stack seeded with MonthRefreshKey's value (month index + played id). F = intel factor / 1000; noIntel = played spies there (level) < 1000, cleared by the `spy` cheat; u = clamp((1 - F) + 0.1, 0.1, 1.0), 0 under the cheat; bonus = SPY_INTEL_MISSION_BONUS / 1000, **applied whatever missions are set**. counter_intel = SPYMISSION_COUNTER_ESPIONAGE_TITLE + ': ' + ('?' or FFP(RandomPerturbClamped(chosen's own level x mission_share[0] / 1000, 0, 10000, u), 0)). The seven goods (energy, metal, raremat, oil, fuel, supplies, money in that order) = '?' or FormatEstimatedStock(good 5, 4, 6, 3, 1, 0, 2) with spread clamp(u - played OFFMAP_INDUSTRY_INTEL, 0, 1) x (1 - bonus). ic_number = '?/?/?' or (avail > 0 '§R' else '§G') + GetAvailableIC + '/' + (max_ic > TotalIC '§R' else '§G') + max_ic + '/' + TotalIC, exact. dissent = FFP(Clamped(dissent, 0, 100000, u x (1 - bonus)), 2); national unity = FFP(Clamped(unity, 0, 100000, u), 1); diplomacy = FFP(AtLeast(diplo_influence, or 100.000 under [0x1BEA410], floor 0, scale 100000, u), 0); manpower = FFP(AtLeast(manpower, 0, 100000, u), 0); leadership = FFPTrimmed(AtLeast(TotalLeadership, 0, 100000, u)); espionage = itoa(AtLeast(spy_pool, 0, 10000, u) / 1000) - each '?' under noIntel, the draw made either way. Then FillResearchLists(view, gen, u, F) and FillPopularityChart. A copy of the played presence is made at [esp+0x174] and never read. `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-espionage.md, D.4.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x624970-0x6266F9 read end to end (dump in the reader's scratch): seed at 0x624B7B (0xAA2BF0, eax = month + [esp+0x88] the played id); noIntel 0x624BD0 and the cheat 0x624BEE; the clamp 0x624BF4-0x624D90; bonus 0x624C55; the counter-intel perturbation 0x624D3B with pushes 10000 / 0 / base; industry intel +0x1E8 at 0x6250DE; the spreads stored to [esp+0x40] and [esp+0x18] at 0x625154/0x62515A; each figure's pushes (0x186A0, 0x2710) and decimals; `ret 4` at 0x6266F9.
